Package org.saidone.repository

Class OzoneRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
org.saidone.repository.OzoneRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
OzoneRepository
Direct Known Subclasses:
EncryptedOzoneRepositoryImpl
@Service @ConditionalOnExpression("\'${application.service.vault.storage.impl}\' == \'ozone\' and \'${application.service.vault.encryption.content.enabled:false}\' == \'false\'") public class OzoneRepositoryImpl extends Object implements OzoneRepository
Default OzoneRepository implementation relying on the native Ozone RPC client OzoneBucket. The class exposes basic methods to upload and download objects using a provided OzoneBucket instance.

The bean is created only when application.service.vault.encryption.content.enabled is set to false or omitted and application.service.vault.storage.impl equals "ozone".

  • Method Details

    • prepareContent

      public InputStream prepareContent(InputStream content, Map<String,String> metadata)
      Returns the stream of the bytes to store for the given content, encrypted when content encryption is enabled, and records in metadata how they are stored. The caller writes this stream to the file then passed to OzoneRepository.putObject(java.lang.String, java.nio.file.Path, java.util.Map<java.lang.String, java.lang.String>), so plain content never reaches the disk when encryption is enabled.
      Specified by:
      prepareContent in interface OzoneRepository
      Parameters:
      content - the original content; closing the returned stream closes it
      metadata - object metadata, updated with the storage details
      Returns:
      the stream of the bytes to store

      Specified by:
